corrections.text: The article gives fast mode and standard prices for Claude Opus 5.5 ($8 and $40 versus $4 and $20 per million input and output tokens) without stating when they were retrieved. These figures reflect Anthropic's pricing page and fast mode documentation as read on October 17, 2026; the pricing page itself directs readers to claude.com/pricing for the most current prices, and the figures may change.
